PROJECT Eden Initiative — Twenty-Five Years After 9/11 — 2001–2026 /
2026–2051

AUTHOR / PROJECT Eden Initiative Lucas Buzek

OBJECTIVE Take the EXISTING Eden Initiative Twenty-Five Years After 9/11
project from its current state to a complete, research-validated,
multilingual, publication-ready and web-deployable release.

Do not restart research unnecessarily. First recover and evaluate all
existing work. Reuse reliable existing work and research only missing
evidence, outdated evidence, weak claims, contradictions, newly required
evidence and publication-specific gaps.

PHASE 1 — THREAD RECOVERY Recover all available material relating to
Twenty-Five Years After 9/11, 25th Anniversary research, Eden
Initiative, alternative-history research, 2001–2026 timeline, post-9/11
mobilization, development counterfactuals, Eden manifesto, Eden research
thesis and 2026–2051 forward programme. Known prior artifacts may
include: Eden_Initiative_White_Paper_25_Years_After_9-11_2026
Eden_Initiative_Step2_Alternative_History_Research_Review
Eden_Initiative_Manifesto_Research_Thesis_2026_Enhanced and related
source/research material. Do not assume a referenced artifact is
available. Locate and verify it before relying on it. Build the
canonical research corpus. Recover claims, sources, citations,
calculations, tables, timelines, arguments, counterarguments,
methodology, previous conclusions and drafts. Classify: FACT /
CALCULATION / ESTIMATE / ASSUMPTION / COUNTERFACTUAL / INTERPRETATION.
Automatically hand off to ARGOS.

PHASE 2 — ARGOS RESEARCH COMPLETION Verify the corpus. Historical
period: 2001–2026. Forward analytical period: 2026–2051. Research
domains: security expenditure; resource mobilization; water; sanitation;
energy; food; agriculture; health; education; infrastructure;
manufacturing; science; R&D; technology; communications; institutional
capacity; human development; resilience. Counterfactual scenarios: 1% /
5% / 10% / 25% / equivalent mobilization. Do not model money as the only
constraint. Include deployment capacity, human capital, institutions,
supply chains, manufacturing, technology availability, politics,
geography, maintenance and governance. Use RED TEAM analysis.

PHASE 3 — ARGOS PUBLICATION PROGRAMME Establish EIRS — Eden Initiative
Research Series. Flagship: EIRS-2026-001 — Twenty-Five Years After 9/11
Working subtitle: What Humanity Chose to Optimize — and What the Next
Twenty-Five Years Could Build Mine the corpus for every genuinely
independent publication it supports. Potential subjects include scale of
mobilization; water; sanitation; energy; food systems; agriculture;
human-scale infrastructure; manufacturing; technology deployment;
deployment gap; security and resilience; human development;
institutional capacity; cost of delay; local capability; resilient
communities; 2026–2051 scenarios; Eden deployment doctrine; Eden
technology doctrine; Eden measurement framework. Do not force
unsupported papers. Create EIRS PUBLICATION MATRIX.

PHASE 4 — CASPER ENGLISH PUBLICATIONS Create canonical English
publications. For the flagship include as appropriate: title; abstract;
executive summary; research question; historical context; methodology;
evidence; analysis; counterfactual scenarios; limitations;
counterarguments; findings; 2026–2051 implications; conclusion;
references; appendices. Generate appropriate derivative publications:
policy briefs, executive editions, public editions, funder briefs, web
articles, FAQs and data notes.

PHASE 5 — ARGOS QA Audit sources, citations, numbers, dates, units,
calculations, assumptions, scenario boundaries, geography, populations,
chronology, counterarguments and limitations. Red-team conclusions.
Return defects to CASPER and repeat automatically until BLOCKING=0 and
MAJOR=0. Lock EN_MASTER_APPROVED.

PHASE 6 — AOS v2.0 Create synchronized EN, SK and DE editions. English
remains canonical. Create TERMINOLOGY_MASTER, TRANSLATION_MEMORY and
SEGMENT_MAP. Apply SEMANTIC LOCK, NUMBER LOCK, CITATION LOCK, FORMAT
MIRROR and SOURCE VERSION LOCK. Every approved publication must be
produced as EN TXT, EN RTF, SK TXT, SK RTF, DE TXT and DE RTF. Run
independent Slovak and German language QA, then ARGOS
factual-equivalence QA. Correct automatically.

PHASE 7 — WEAVER Create the complete multilingual project website with
/en/ /sk/ /de/ routing.

Each publication page: ID / title / abstract / version / authors / date

RTF / DE TXT / DE RTF.

WEBSITE VISUAL LANGUAGE Professional international research institute.
Evidence first. Avoid sensationalism. Visually distinguish ACTUAL
HISTORY / COUNTERFACTUAL / FORWARD SCENARIO. Use meaningful timelines,
charts, comparison graphics, maps, data visualizations and publication
cards. Use @IRIS for original supporting imagery where appropriate.
Never present generated imagery as documentary historical evidence.

WEBSITE ENGINEERING Mobile first; fast; minimal unnecessary
dependencies; semantic HTML; accessibility-conscious; SEO optimized.
Implement canonical URLs, hreflang, OpenGraph, structured data,
publication metadata, sitemap.xml, robots.txt, responsive images and
lazy loading. Create PUBLICATION_MANIFEST.json as the publication source
of truth.

PHASE 8 — FINAL QA ARGOS: facts and research. CASPER: editorial
consistency. AOS: EN/SK/DE equivalence. WEAVER: functionality,
accessibility, performance, SEO and download integrity. Errors return
automatically to their owner and affected downstream stages are
retested.

PHASE 9 — PACKAGE Follow Universal Project Packaging Standard. Root:

03_PUBLICATIONS/ 04_TRANSLATION/ 05_WEBSITE/ 06_QA/ 07_DEPLOYMENT/
08_ARCHIVE/ Use TXT for human-readable instructions wherever practical.
Include QUICKSTART.txt, PROJECT_INFO.txt, PUBLICATION_INDEX.txt,
